description:
Kalpesh Wamanrao Jejurkar
Expert Academic Counselor & Mentor

With over 15 years of experience in the education sector, my focus has always been on guiding students through some of the most important academic decisions of their lives. I work closely with students from 9th to 12th grade, helping them build clarity, confidence, and a structured approach toward their future.

I provide guidance on selecting the right academic board, choosing suitable streams, and preparing strategically for competitive exams such as JEE, CET, and NEET. I believe that academic success is not just about hard work, but about making the right decisions at the right time.

My counselling approach is centered on understanding each student’s strengths, reducing confusion, and creating a practical roadmap that aligns with their long-term goals.
